description: Represents a single column assignment (one entry of the SQL SET clause).

value.description: Literal JSON value to assign to the field in each target document: string, number, boolean, object, array, or null. Omit the "value" property to remove/unset the field (`undefined`); include `"value": null` to store JSON null. Must be a literal constant — no SQL or expressions; value is bound and stored as-is.
